settings.hero_desc: A clean scale model of a passenger ferry, finished in white with an accent stripe and presented on a blue LED-lit base. A premium showpiece and gift for ferry operators, shipbuilders and marine firms.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your vessel, livery, name and lit base
settings.s1_body: We recreate your ferry or passenger vessel as an accurate scale model - hull, decks, superstructure and fittings - finished in your livery and presented on a striking LED-lit base. The ideal piece to mark a launch, gift a client or display in a reception, built faithfully from your drawings.
settings.case_body: Built as a special gift from Unique Group for their client, this model became the centrepiece of the operator's reception - the vessel recreated to scale on a glowing base, a memorable gift to impress their client.
settings.case_quote: A beautiful likeness of our ferry, and the lit base makes it a real showpiece.
settings.case_quote_attr: Jiju - Marketing head at Unique Group
settings.prov_p: A faithful model honours the vessel; a lit base turns it into a showpiece. Together they make a launch or milestone something people stop to admire.
